resolution.observationPoint: When the new Congress resulting from the 2026 elections first completes organization of both chambers, after any legally necessary runoffs, certification and final effective judicial decisions.
resolution.houseControl: Formal Speaker party and majority organizational arrangements.
resolution.senateControl: Actual caucus affiliation, organizational arrangements and any necessary vice-presidential tie-breaking authority; include independents by organizational affiliation and all non-contested seats.
resolution.unresolvedCases: Wait where elections, shared control or cross-party arrangements do not establish control. Neither election night nor January 3 is an automatic settlement deadline. Later party changes, special elections or leadership changes do not retroactively change the original result.
retainedAmbiguities: Exactly which formal actions complete organization was not exhaustively specified.
If chambers organize at different times, the treatment of an intervening change needs interpretation from the original rule and official records.
